sections_target.text: This document sets out the steps for the annual maintenance of the processing and logic control unit.

The first draft was prepared by Eng. Hassan Mousa Hassan, tested by Eng. Ramadan Farrag Ahmed, approved by Eng. Mohamed Nasr El-Din Ahmed, and approved by Eng. Youssef Mahmoud Ali, General Manager of the station.

rows: A work order must be opened
The unit is out of service and in test mode
Disconnect the power supply to the processing unit when changing the power supplies or the fans
Remove the filters from the cabinet doors
Clean the cabinet cards with the blower
Clean and wash the filters, then dry them and refit them afterwards
Check all the fans, including the power supply fans, and replace any faulty one
Check the output voltages of the power supplies and adjust them as per the table
Visually inspect the condition of the cards and replace any faulty one
Check the signals in coordination with the various departments

Introduction
This document sets out the steps for the annual maintenance of the processing and logic control unit.
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Hassan Mousa Hassan, tested by Eng. Ramadan Farrag Ahmed, approved by Eng. Mohamed Nasr El-Din Ahmed, and approved by Eng. Youssef Mahmoud Ali, General Manager of the station.
Safety Precautions

uncertain_terms.note: Source 'مغذيات الفدرة' is a typo for 'مغذيات القدرة' (power supplies); rendered as 'power supplies'.
Suspect value: V4 is given as '- 03.5 v' in both tables (probably -3.5 V); kept verbatim.
The two set-value tables differ: the first gives V1/V2 without a '+' sign (5.15 v, 15.28 v), the second with '+' (+ 5.15 v, + 15.28 v); both kept verbatim.
The footer form fields read 'Site name: Breaker code:' on this instrumentation document; rendered literally as in the source.
